curated.lethality_detail_zh: 高发于50岁以上中老年人的中心视力杀手（不直接致命），分为干性（萎缩型，占85%）与湿性（渗出/新生血管型，占15%但导致90%的严重失明）；一旦发生湿性黄斑新生血管出血渗漏，数周内即可造成看东西扭曲变形、中心黑影遮挡乃至法定盲。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 湿性AMD已通过玻璃体腔注射抗VEGF单抗（康柏西普、雷珠单抗、阿柏西普及双靶点法瑞西单抗）实现高度稳控，多数患者规范连续打针可保住甚至提升中心视力；干性晚期（地图样萎缩）海外已获批补体C3/C5抑制剂，国内尚在推进中。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD未单列直接死因，是全球50岁以上人群不可逆中心视力丧失的最主要原因之一
annual_deaths_global.source: WHO Blindness and Vision Impairment / IHME GBD

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患者规模约1.9亿–2亿例（早期及晚期合计），随老龄化预计2040年逼近2.88亿例
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国40–89岁成人任何类型AMD患病率约4.7%（早期4.06%、晚期0.64%），患者总数达数千万例，居全球前列

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 湿性黄斑突发视物变形警报：1) 若看门框直线突然变弯、视野正中出现暗点或视力骤降，高度提示黄斑新生血管急性出血渗漏，须在1–2周内尽快就诊眼科行OCT及眼底造影检查并尽早启动抗VEGF眼内注药，拖延数月形成黄斑瘢痕后视力将永久无法挽回。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 居家贴一张“阿姆斯勒方格表（Amsler Grid）”：每天单眼分别注视中心黑点，一旦发现方格线条扭曲立即就医
坚决戒烟（吸烟是AMD最可控的强危险因素，风险增加2–4倍），户外佩戴防紫外线/蓝光太阳镜

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 双抗法瑞西单抗（TENAYA/LUCERNE 3期）及高剂量阿柏西普（8mg）将湿性AMD给药间隔延长至16周；2) 针对干性晚期“地图样萎缩”的补体C3抑制剂Pegcetacoplan与C5抑制剂Avacincaptad pegol已获FDA批准；3) 一次性AAV抗VEGF基因治疗（如ABBV-RGX-314、ADVM-022）及iPSC视网膜色素上皮细胞移植正在临床推进中。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 患者需要长期反复到医院进行眼内打针，老年行动不便者极易半途放弃导致视力反弹失明；2) 中国尚缺乏获批的干性晚期地图样萎缩靶向药物；3) 基层眼科缺乏OCT设备导致大量早期干/湿性AMD被误当成“老花眼或白内障”。

master.definition_en: Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD) deficiency isaconditionin which the body cannot break down the nucleotides thymine and uracil. DPD deficiency can have a wide range of severity; some individuals may have various neurological problems, while others have no signsand symptoms. Signs and symptoms in severely affected individuals begin in infancy and may include seizures, intellectual disability, microcephaly, increased muscle tone (hypertonia), delayed motor skills, and autistic behavior. All individuals with the condition, regardless of the presence or severity of symptoms, are at risk for severe, toxic reactions to drugs called fluoropyrimidines which are used to treat cancer. Individuals with no symptoms may be diagnosed only by laboratory testing or after exposure to fluoropyrimidines. DPD deficiency is caused by mutations in the DPYD gene and is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner.

master.definition_en: Primary essential cutis verticis gyrata is a rare, progressive dermis disorder characterized by thickening of the scalp resulting in redundancy of the skin which gives rise to folds and grooves that give the scalp a cerebriform appearance. Folds cannot be corrected by pressure or traction and typically are symmetric and extend anteroposteriorly from vertex to occiput and/or transversely in occipital region. Additional features may include mild subungual hyperkeratosis and distal onycholysis of the nail plates of the great toes. It is not associated with neurological and ophthalmological changes, nor with secondary causes.

master.definition_en: A group of extremely rare, inherited, progressive skeletal conditions that result in a particular form of short stature, called short-limb dwarfism. The short stature is the result of unusually short forearms and forelegs (mesomelia) and abnormal shortening of the bones in the hands and feet (acromelia). At birth, the hands and feet may appear abnormally short and broad. Over time, the apparent disproportion becomes even more obvious, especially during the first years of life. Additional features may include: limited extension of the elbows and arms; progressive abnormal curvature of the spine; an enlarged head; and a slightly flattened midface. Acromesomelic dysplasia is inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. There are different types of acromesomelic dysplasia, which are distinguished by their genetic cause. master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by idiopathic orbital inflammation in which the specific target tissue is the optic nerve sheath. Patients typically present with ocular pain, pain on eye movement, visual symptoms with loss of vision progressing over several weeks, dyschromatopsia, and variable visual field defects. Orbital signs and symptoms may be present and include ptosis, ophthalmoplegia, and exophthalmos. Optic disk edema is observed in most cases. The condition is usually unilateral.

master.definition_en: Any acute myeloid leukemia that has the chromosomal anomaly t(6;11)(q27;q23). It is associated with the development of de novo acute myeloid leukemia.)

master.definition_en: A rare genetic disease characterized by multiple intestinal atresia in association with combined immunodeficiency and inflammatory bowel disease. Clinical features include widespread atresia extending from the stomach to the rectum, homogenous calcifications in the abdominal cavity, hepatic cholestasis, cirrhosis, and chronic liver failure, hypoplastic thymus, and increased susceptibility to mainly bacteria and viruses. The immunological phenotype consists of profound generalized T-cell lymphopenia and milder natural killer cell and B-cell lymphopenia, as well as low serum levels of IgG, IgA, and IgM, with elevated serum IgE. The disease is mostly fatal in infancy or childhood.
synonyms_en: multiple intestinal atresia and/or inflammatory bowel disease with or without immunodeficiency

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A friable, benign vascular neoplasm with lobular capillary architecture that presents as a raised red skin growth.
